program_name: Online Master of Public Health – Public Health Technology

programme_facts.value: Arizona State University’s online Master of Public Health in public health technology prepares you with the skills needed to support healthy communities by providing a foundational understanding of public health best practices and new technology. You’ll learn to assess and address health challenges using evidence-based strategies and technology-informed tools. This program will also show you how to make lasting improvements in population health, whether your goal is community-driven impact or systems-level transformation.
